description: The ATI TEAS is an ATI admissions assessment of entry-level reading, mathematics, science, and English-language skills, while the ATI Content Mastery Series RN Fundamentals exam is an ATI nursing-content assessment aligned with the NCLEX-RN test plan.
title: ATI TEAS and ATI Content Mastery Series RN Fundamentals exam

description: ATI-UP is a preventive, school-wide, multi-tiered attendance intervention developed for school teams to promote attendance and reduce chronic absenteeism through problem-solving, family and community engagement, attendance promotion, and behavior motivation.
title: ATI-UP

description: AtlasGPT is a neurosurgery-focused large language model grounded in peer-reviewed sources, developed for neurosurgical information retrieval and examination preparation.
title: AtlasGPT

description: ATR CALL BRIX is web-based TOEIC preparation courseware with integrated LMS materials, activity tracking, feedback, and monitoring functions, developed by ATR CALL.
title: ATR CALL BRIX

description: A manualized 10-session parenting programme developed by Mary Dozier and colleagues and delivered by trained interventionists to help caregivers provide nurturing, synchronous care to young children who have experienced adversity.
title: Attachment and Biobehavioral Catch-up (ABC) intervention

description: A pair of Likert-type self-report instruments developed by Atasoy and Ertürk and Yavetz and Pe'er, respectively, for measuring students' environmental attitudes and behaviors.
title: Attitude Scale toward Environment (ASTE) and Behavior Scale toward Environment (BSTE)

description: A 45-item, four-factor Likert instrument developed by Demir and Akpınar to measure undergraduate students' attitudes toward mobile learning.
title: Attitude Scale Toward Mobile Learning

description: A 12-item, five-point Likert self-report instrument adapted from Kenar and Balcı's scale to measure elementary students' attitudes toward science courses.
title: Attitude Scale towards Science Course (12-item 5-point Likert scale)

description: A 31-item five-point Likert assessment developed by Kececi and Kirbag Zengin to measure students' attitudes toward science lessons.
title: Attitude Scale towards Science Lesson (Kececi & Kirbag Zengin, 2015)

description: The SKS is a 25-item five-point Likert assessment developed by Ayvacı (2007) to measure attitudes toward scientific knowledge and views about its nature.
title: Attitude Scale towards Scientific Knowledge (SKS)

description: A 22-item Likert self-report scale developed by Hameed et al.
title: Attitude-toward-physics-curriculum scale (22 Likert items)

description: An eight-item self-report instrument developed by Bauer and adapted into Turkish by Sen, Yilmaz, and Temel to measure undergraduate students' cognitive and affective attitudes toward chemistry.
title: Attitude toward the Subject of Chemistry Inventory (ASCI)

description: A 25-item five-point Likert self-report instrument adapted from TIMSS and prior mathematics-attitude measures to assess students' self-confidence, liking, perceived usefulness, and anxiety toward mathematics.
title: Attitudes toward Mathematics Inventory (ATMI)

description: Awofala's study-developed battery comprising an attitudes inventory, an interest-preference inventory, and parallel personalised and non-personalised mathematics word-problem instructional materials.
title: Attitudes toward Mathematics Word Problem Inventory (ATMWPI), Students' Interest Inventory (SII), and Instructional Programme on Mathematics Word Problem (IPMW)

description: The ATTS is a modified 29-item attitude scale developed by Litam in collaboration with the original APPS developers to measure counselors' views of trafficked women and sex trafficking using person-first language.
title: Attitudes Toward Trafficked Women and Sex Trafficking Scale (ATTS)

description: A 12-item, five-point Likert self-report scale developed by Serçe Hüseyin et al.
title: Attitudes Towards Teaching Profession Scale (ATTPS)
